maddeler.e:
ينتقض (form VIII)
# يَنْتَقِضُ (yantaqiḍu) /jan.ta.qi.dˤu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَقَضَ (intaqaḍa)
# يَنْتَقِضَ (yantaqiḍa) /jan.ta.qi.dˤa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَقَضَ (intaqaḍa)
# يَنْتَقِضْ (yantaqiḍ) /jan.ta.qidˤ/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْتَقَضَ (intaqaḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
